intelligence.essence: Memberships & Earning is how you turn what you know and love into something people pay to be part of — and how every citizen becomes an ambassador. Build a membership on any page — your Personal World, your Business, your Space — charge for access, and earn from genuine value you provide.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have the coolest clubhouse in the neighborhood, and people pay a little bit to join because it's so much fun inside — and you get to keep what they pay, and even share it with the friends who told them about it. That's a membership: your club, your rules, your earnings.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine opening a little shop where people pay to become members — and they get your best recipes, your stories, your teaching — and you keep what they pay, fair and square, with no middleman taking a piece. That's a membership: your work, your reward.
